text:
Asha: noticed something odd in staging cost dashboard: prefetch savings went negative for tenant `acme-inc` at ~03:14
Ben: negative savings? that's probably a visualization artifact, but can you paste the view?
Asha: screenshot in thread, console shows -$1200 on the Prefetch line for that hour
Rina: hmm we recently added sidecar telemetry that emits prefetch credits. router also emits them. we tried dedupe but sample windows might overlap
DevOps Bot: deploy(econ-emitter): canary started for econ-emitter@canary-20241203
Tom: quick mitigation: can we clamp the UI to never show negative prefetch, and add "estimated" label so customers don't freak out? low-risk change
Hannah: sales demo at 09:30 too, agreed hide negatives until we fix the pipeline
Ben: I'll run a count: `SELECT sum(credits) FROM prefetch_events WHERE tenant='acme-inc' AND hour=1729300000;` -> returns 0.9M credits, seems high
Kai: add `emitter_id` and `prefetch_source` tags to events (router|sidecar|batcher) + an `orig_event_id` for dedupe. That should let us separate duplicates downstream
Rina: will update the emitter schema, but note this is a breaking ingest change. need coordinated rollout with consumers
Asha: frontend PR to clamp and add tooltip: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/12567 (patch in flight)
DevOps Bot: canary succeeded for console@patch-1729300123
Tom: follow-up: surface per-model SKU breakdown on the Prefetch card. right now the rollup hides which SKUs are being credited and that's important for cost ops
Ben: agreed. add `model_sku` and `quant_profile` to econ events, ingestion will tag them and dashboard can show a stacked sparkline by SKU
Hannah: UX: include an "Estimation confidence" badge (high/medium/low) driven by dedupe_confidence and sample_rate. tooltip explaining the calcs
Kai: creating an alert rule: `prefetch_savings < 0 OR prefetch_fraction > 0.5` -> notify #eng-platform and tenant owner. We can auto-attach recent raw events for triage
Rina: also propose an internal debug view that can show raw prefetch events for a tenant (with source tag) so we can quickly tell if it's duplication vs negative adjustments
Asha: timeline? need UI quickfix before the morning demo, schema bump can be next sprint but prefer staged rollouts
Ben: I'll run validation queries comparing sampled ingestion vs full logs after Rina's emitter change lands
Tom: I'll mock the alert card in Figma and share for review
Hannah: I'll message sales and ops to avoid the slide, and prepare a one-liner explanation for customers if asked
Asha: will confirm when console patch is promoted to prod and post canary metrics here
Ben: adding one more ask: expose a toggle "include prefetch estimates" on tenant cost panel so teams can opt-out of estimates when presenting
Rina: noted. we'll include a flaggable rollout for that UX toggle so it's safe to enable gradually
Asha: thanks everyone. if the UI patch holds we'll close this thread; otherwise we'll escalate to #incidents
